CHAPTER 1 — INTRODUCTION

Three kinds of work.
One habit: accuracy.

Imad has spent nearly four years running branch and supermarket operations in Algeria — staff, inventory, pricing and daily reporting — and six years building online channels that reached about 36K followers. Now based in Doha with a valid Qatar ID (QID), he is ready to start.

Alongside that, he has spent four years as an independent financial-markets and blockchain analyst, reading order books, on-chain data and price structure. The foundation underneath it is a biochemical-analysis degree — the same close-reading, keep-the-records-straight discipline, just pointed at charts instead of samples.

Day to day he works in Excel and Word, edits video and photos on his phone, uses AI tools for research and visuals, and works in Arabic, English and French. Fifteen certifications from Google, Coursera and Binance Academy back the self-study — from digital marketing to risk, portfolio management and blockchain.

He publishes market analysis on Binance Square under the_unique_dz and runs a Web3-focused community on Telegram at @D1337.
